sources.source: CLP Power Hong Kong Electricity Sales Disclosures
sources.notes: Quarterly electricity sales in GWh broken down by customer sector (Residential, Commercial, Infrastructure & Public Services, Manufacturing) plus AI Data-Centre demand growth.
Monthly town gas consumption in Terajoules (TJ) by user type (Domestic, Commercial, Industrial) — de facto Towngas monopoly operational proxy.

sources.source: Hong Kong Observatory Daily Mean Temperature
sources.notes: Daily mean temperature (°C) and monthly averages — primary physical weather driver for air-conditioning power load.

sources.source: Power Assets Holdings Geographic Segment Reporting
sources.notes: Semi-annual geographic segment reporting note (revenue, segment profit, share of JV/associate results) broken out by Investment in HKEI, United Kingdom, Australia, and Others.

sources.source: DSD Daily Sewage Flow and Effluent Laboratory Data
sources.notes: Daily final-effluent flow and sparse laboratory observations (BOD, TSS, nitrogen, oil/grease, pH and E. coli) by sewage treatment works; treatment-works coverage changes over time.

Current planned and emergency water-suspension notices with district, affected address, start/resumption time, cause and current status; refreshed every five minutes and not a continuous consumption series.
